description: Deterministic policy for the research-proposal novelty and feasibility skill. Thresholds are applied mechanically by scripts/sk_entry.py; no network or model call is made.

overlap.rule: share of proposal content terms found in a record's title/abstract, plus a small bonus for shared two-word phrases

status.success: a proposal and at least one prior-art record are present, the proposal is falsifiable as written, and resources are declared
status.partial: the proposal or the prior-art batch is present but falsifiability, resources or comparison coverage is incomplete
status.insufficient_input: no proposal or no prior-art record was supplied, so no novelty statement is made
status.failed: the case file could not be read or the analysis raised an unhandled error

evidence.locator_rule: locators are JSON pointers into the supplied case.json (for example /prior_art/0), never page numbers of a generated document
evidence.quote_rule: quotes are exact substrings of the cited field; truncation keeps a prefix and sets truncated=true
evidence.unverifiable_rule: a statement without a locator goes to needs_human_confirmation instead of evidence

no_fabrication: never invent papers, years, DOIs, sample sizes, ethics approvals or effect sizes
never turn an empty batch into a claim of global novelty
never turn a batch-missing conflict into agreement
source_declaration: All sources are the records supplied in the case file; the skill performs no external retrieval and does not verify that the records exist.
